sn18.3:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Taṃ kiṃ maññasi Rāhula || || Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti || || Aniccam bhante || || Sotaviññāṇam || Ghānaviññāṇam || Jivhāviññāṇam || Kāyaviññāṇaṃ || Manoviññāṇam niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti || || Aniccaṃ bhante || || Evam passaṃ Rāhula sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhuviññāṇasmim pi nibbindati || Sotaviññāṇasmim pi nibbindati || Ghānaviññāṇasmim pi || || Jivhāviññāṇasmim pi || || Kāyaviññāṇasmim pi || || Manoviññāṇasmim pi nibbindati || || Nibbindaṃ virajjati || pe|| pajānātīti || || Tatiyaṃ || ||
